def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} 
  (zero : motive 0) 
  (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) 
  (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
  if n == 0 then
    zero
  else
    let b : Bool := n % 2 == 1
    let n' : ℕ := n / 2
    bit b n' (VTask.binaryRec zero bit n')
